patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Amplemarket and Cognism share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Amplemarket only if your buying job matches “AI-powered multichannel outbound platform combining lead intelligence, sequences, delivera” rather than Cognism's shape. Choose Cognism only if your buying job matches “Compliance-first B2B sales intelligence with phone-verified Diamond Data® mobiles, strong ” rather than Amplemarket's shape. Workflow advantage: Amplemarket leans sales-engagement, email-outreach; Cognism leans data-enrichment, contact-management. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Amplemarket and Cognism share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Amplemarket is AI-powered multichannel outbound platform combining lead intelligence, sequences, deliverability, and Duo AI assistants.; Cognism is Compliance-first B2B sales intelligence with phone-verified Diamond Data® mobiles, strong EMEA coverage, and CRM enrichment — quote-led Sale.
- Workflow coverage skew: Amplemarket-leaning sales-engagement, email-outreach vs Cognism-leaning data-enrichment, contact-management.
- Researched limits: Amplemarket — Not a full CRM pipeline system of record.; Cognism — Not a native email sequencer — push contacts into Outreach/Salesloft or CRM for outreach.

Limitations — Amplemarket: Not a full CRM pipeline system of record.; Startup already $600/mo annual; Growth/Elite are custom-quoted.; Cognism: Not a native email sequencer — push contacts into Outreach/Salesloft or CRM for outreach; Sales Prospecting Standard/Pro list prices are not published on /pricing.

Poor-fit cases: Amplemarket is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a full CRM pipeline system of record. · Cognism is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a native email sequencer — push contacts into Outreach/Salesloft or CRM for outreach · Avoid Amplemarket if you actually need Cognism's motion (Compliance-first B2B sales intelligence with phone-verified Diamond Data® mobile)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
